name: Podcast
description: Episodes with script and show notes drafted separately, judged on whether a listener stays past the first two minutes, scheduled into a feed and shipped as a release.

axes.label: Hook
axes.description: Does the cold open earn the next thirty seconds?

axes.label: Clarity
axes.description: Could a listener explain the point to someone else afterward?

axes.label: Pacing
axes.description: Where does it drag, and would a listener skip ahead?

axes.label: Insight
axes.description: Is there a claim here nobody else is making, or just a summary?

axes.label: Delivery
axes.description: Energy, pauses, whether it sounds read or spoken.

axes.label: Shareability
axes.description: Is there a moment worth clipping and sending to a friend?

prompts.label: Critique the script
prompts.description: Where a listener would tap away.

prompts.label: Test the cold open
prompts.description: Is the first thirty seconds worth the listener's time?

prompts.label: Check show notes against the script
prompts.description: Do the notes actually describe what was said?

prompts.label: Pick clip candidates
Score the episode
prompts.description: Rate it along the profile axes, with a reason.
prompts.template:
Here are the notes for an episode called "{title}".

{body}

Judge it along these axes: Hook (Does the cold open earn the next thirty seconds), Clarity (Could a listener explain the point to someone else afterward), Pacing (Where does it drag, and would a listener skip ahead), Insight (Is there a claim here nobody else is making, or just a summary), Delivery (Energy, pauses, whether it sounds read or spoken), Shareability (Is there a moment worth clipping and sending to a friend).

Be honest rather than kind: a score that flatters is worth nothing.
